content.text:
I built the part and exported it to `submission.step`. It matches the four reference views with a score of 0.993; each view scores between 0.987 and 0.996.

The part is a flat plate measuring 140 (X) × 8 (Y) × 100 (Z), so it stands upright with its thin side along Y. It has 24 through-holes, each 8 in diameter, in 6 columns by 4 rows spaced 20 apart and centred on the plate. When read back, the STEP file is one valid solid with the same volume and bounding box as `part.FCStd`.

The proportions came from comparing against the renders, so they're estimates. A plate 6 thick with holes 7 across and spaced 19 apart scored lower, at 0.915. The final solid was built with a script, so it isn't an editable feature tree. That doesn't matter for this STEP deliverable.
